description:
Relive the best moments of the #Huawei #ICTCompetition 2025–2026 Global Final, where young innovators applied ICT skills to address real world needs across industries.
 
Participants from around the world demonstrated practical skills, technical focus, and innovation across competition tracks at the final stage in Shenzhen, tackling challenges through hands-on problem solving.
 
As a global platform for competition and exchange, the Huawei ICT Competition brings together students and teachers from colleges and universities to strengthen ICT knowledge, foster innovation, and develop future-ready talent for the digital economy.
 
Learn more about the Huawei ICT Competition 2025–2026 Global Final and watch the livestream replay: https://bit.ly/4vhgs18 #ICTheFuture
title: I. C. The World: Future ICT Leaders Drive Innovation
